messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — high-severity: cross-region health flapping detected. us-east <-> eu-west <-> us-west probe failures triggering fallback churn; >30% increase in 502s for inference route 'text-gen-prod' in last 5m. paging oncall-sre and ml-oncall. incident id INC-2026-0456

oncall-sre: acked. I'm booting into the routing dashboard now.

laura-ng: I'm seeing repeated healthcheck toggles between us-east and eu-west in the last 3m. Each toggle triggers fallback logic that spins traffic around. latency spikes on warm calls.

anjali-ml: could be the recently rolled model-variant tag 'v3-llama-q4' in eu-west causing slightly longer cold start + KV cache warmups, tripping the health thresholds.

ryan-eng: logs show probe latency > 2s then immediate success, then fail again. healthcheck windows are 10s with 2 consecutive fails -> mark unhealthy. combined with immediate fallback TTL=0 causes hop loop.

ops-bot: put link to dashboard https://console.redwood.internal/routing/INC-2026-0456 (redacted)

oncall-sre: quick mitigation: pausing auto-fallback for route text-gen-prod in us-east for 15m. executing: `redwoodctl routing update --route text-gen-prod --auto-fallback false --note "mitigate probe spiral"`

laura-ng: +1. That should stop the immediate churn. Not sure about customer impact yet.

pagerduty-bot: oncall-sre acknowledged at 1769994350.

anjali-ml: while fallback paused, we should patch healthcheck debounce to 30s and increase consecutive_failures to 3 in eu-west to avoid oscillation. Suggest config snippet:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  healthcheck:
    window_seconds: 30
    consecutive_failures: 3
    debounce_ttl_seconds: 30
```

ryan-eng: I'm going to open a safe rollout: apply debounce in eu-west only first. If that looks good, apply to all regions.

kate-product: any customer-facing impact? any paying customers seeing errors?

laura-ng: we have elevated error rates for a handful of tenants tied to text-gen-prod. No site-wide outage. Customer success alerted for affected orgs.

oncall-sre: applied pause to auto-fallback at 1769994380. Doing a canary of debounce change in eu-west now (`redwoodctl config patch --region eu-west --file debounce.yml`).

ops-bot: deploy job started #deploy-789 (eu-west debounce patch). logs: job 1234 -> running.

ryan-eng: monitoring probe behaviour... looks like fails are still noisy but no longer immediately causing fallback. KV cache warms slower for v3-llama-q4, taking ~22s.

anjali-ml: that aligns with model variant differences. We'll add a model-variant health profile to avoid treating slow warmups as unhealthy. New profile: `warmup_tolerance: 40s`.

laura-ng: good. Once stable, we should re-enable auto-fallback with a backoff policy (min cool-down 2m).

pagerduty-bot: post-mitigation check scheduled in 15m.

ops-bot: deploy job #deploy-789 succeeded at 1769994560.

ryan-eng: metrics look better: error rate for text-gen-prod down from +32% to +6% after debounce. No further region hops in last 6m.

laura-ng: re-enabling auto-fallback with cooldown 120s and max retries 2. command: `redwoodctl routing update --route text-gen-prod --auto-fallback true --cooldown 120 --max-retries 2`

oncall-sre: re-enable done at 1769994720. Watching for regressions.

anjali-ml: follow-up tasks: (1) add model warmup profile per variant, (2) make debounce default to 30s for routes with >=1 GPU-backed variant, (3) add alert that correlates probe latency + recent rollout.

kate-product: please draft a short note for customers affected with remediation timeline. CS to send.

laura-ng: drafting now. Will include root cause: combination of new model variant with longer KV warmup and tight healthcheck/fallback config causing cascading region failovers.

ryan-eng: filing a short postmortem and a config-change PR with tests for debounce behavior.

laura-ng: thanks team. I'll close the page once monitoring holds for 30m. :white_check_mark:
